meta.claim: defendant A (claim): the negotiation automaton is initiator/responder symmetric at the Ack twins -- Ack-Rcvd and Ack-Sent are the two one-step-from-Open states, and sec.4.2 describes them in near-verbatim mirror sentences: 'Ack-Received': 'a Configure-Request has been sent and a Configure-Ack has been received. The Restart timer is still running, since a Configure-Ack has not yet been sent' (snapshot txt:945-949) vs 'Ack-Sent': 'a Configure-Request and a Configure-Ack have both been sent, but a Configure-Ack has not yet been received. The Restart timer is running' (snapshot txt:951-956) -- so swapping states 7 <-> 8 with every other state fixed should map the negotiation race onto itself.
meta.construction: order-2 group swapping Ack-Rcvd <-> Ack-Sent (states 7 <-> 8); all other states fixed
meta.why_it_looks_legal: both twins sit between Req-Sent and Opened with the Restart timer running, both drain to Stopped on TO-/RXJ- (txt:789, txt:801) and to Closing on Close (txt:786), and both fall to Starting on Down (txt:784) -- the sec.4.2 sentences are mirror-written
meta.why_it_is_not_a_symmetry: the table breaks the swap even before event names are pinned: among declared cells Ack-Rcvd has 6 edges into Req-Sent (TO+ txt:788, RCA txt:793, RCN txt:794, RTR txt:796, RTA txt:797, RXJ+ txt:800) and 4 self-loops (Open txt:785, RCR- txt:792, RUC txt:799, RXR txt:803), while Ack-Sent has 2 edges into Req-Sent (RCR- txt:792, RTR txt:796) and 8 self-loops (Open, TO+, RCR+, RCN, RTA, RUC, RXJ+, RXR -- txt:785-803); a swap cannot map 6-to-Req-Sent onto 2-to-Req-Sent. The direction of completion also flips: Ack-Rcvd finishes on RCR+ (sca,tlu/9 txt:791) while Ack-Sent finishes on RCA (irc,tlu/9 txt:793)
meta.engineering_anchor: the twin reading is how one shared table serves both negotiation roles: whoever still owes the Configure-Ack is the mirror of whoever still waits for it (sec.4.2 txt:945-956); the RFC itself flags the crossed case as an anomaly, not a symmetry (footnote x, txt:822)
meta.semantics_note: event-class model: semantics declared "fixed" (protocol-true reading); the relabel row is the diagnostic contrast reading
